decisions.reason: Selecting the cover-letter and stamped-Word-file presentation method does not change the limited review scope or the required approval outcome.
The presentation-method selection does not alter the documentation required to verify the physical changes, such as photographs, room identifiers, or location markups.
Choosing how to present the stamped concurrence does not change the Nevada PE's name or license number.
This candidate concerns a separate California credential request for an additional permit project; the Nevada as-built presentation decision does not resolve or modify it.
The source decision concerns presentation of concurrence for the Nevada as-built work, not the separate permit-ready electrical drawing package.
Selecting a concurrence-package presentation method does not change the calculation obligations for the separate additional permit project.
The Nevada as-built cover-letter decision does not affect the separately requested Manual J, Manual S, or Manual D calculations.
